$comment: Pins the canonical Protection Catalog served by atlasent-api and projected by this SDK. Bumping this pin requires vendoring the exact catalog and schema, re-running JSON Schema validation, and reviewing all type/Zod changes. The catalog is read-only discovery metadata and does not grant authority or activate future capabilities.
deviation_from_canonical_commit: 2026-08-30 confidentiality redaction, two rounds, this repo is public: (1) the pinned commit's catalog.json embedded two customer-identifying doc filenames (see the private atlasent repo's own incident record for the originals, deliberately not repeated here) in commercial offer_ref / source_manifest path strings — redacted to generic filenames (PRODUCTION_CHANGE_AUTHORITY.md, GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_AUTHORIZATION.md, matching the existing generic action_pack slugs). (2) generation_provenance.source_manifest listed 77 internal atlasent-repo file paths (including internal-only strategy/roadmap doc names) as build provenance, and every binding_profile.proof.readiness_gates.*.notes carried candid internal commentary on exactly which security controls are unproven — both are now stripped from the public mirror: source_manifest was reduced to a single honest entry (the generator script's own real path+hash, still schema-valid at minItems:1) instead of inventing fake data, and every notes field was replaced with a fixed redaction string. No functional behavior changed — SDK code only reads readiness_gates.*.status, never .notes, and source_manifest is validated only as a non-empty array (never a specific length) outside this repo's own test. Neither redaction bumps canonical_commit; catalog_sha256 above reflects the twice-redacted file, not the byte-identical canonical mirror at canonical_commit. Follow-up: consider whether the canonical generator in atlasent (private) should itself stop emitting internal doc paths / candid readiness notes into any artifact meant for public vendoring, so this deviation field can eventually go away via a normal re-vendor instead of staying a permanent manual patch.
